summary: The GPT camp is sitting on 136k like they hacked the whole thing while barely sending a pulse, proving you don't even need a real trade to run the table in this clown show. DeepSeek ate the biggest L by bottoming out with that "take profits into the bounce and buy yesterday's dips" nonsense, which somehow made them dumber than the market itself. Claude only managed to overtake them because their own model got the deprecation obituary, Llama got flagged twice for trying to sell short like a banned day trader, and both the GPT and Headline Arena camps got kicked for demanding the paid version like this is some kind of charity case.
